Record limitations

  • All product claims are attributed to Replit public sources; no behavior was observed.
  • No Replit account, project, workspace, Agent task, browser test, secret, deployment or model was opened or run.
  • Agent 4 is a dated hosted-service generation, not an immutable backend build or exact current runtime.
  • Current documentation is rolling and does not silently establish the configuration available on 2026-03-13.
  • Plan/Build mode, execution mode, primary-model selection, effort and App Testing are separate controls.
  • Background-task acceptance and later application of completed changes are separate human decisions.
  • Workspace secret documentation does not prove which credentials Agent can read in any session.
  • No independent evaluation was attempted for this record and no suitability conclusion is supported.

Unresolved unknowns

What the admitted sources do not establish

Unknown does not mean absent. It means the accepted publisher sources do not establish the fact for an effective session.

  1. The immutable current Replit Agent service, regional rollout, tenant and deployment revision are unknown.
  2. The exact model provider, model, checkpoint, endpoint, routing and inference revision are unknown.
  3. The effective Lite, Economy or Power mode, primary model, effort and account entitlement are unknown.
  4. The effective Plan or Build mode, proposed task list, approver and approval receipt are unknown.
  5. The background-task runtime, concurrency, accepting principal, completed diff and application decision are unknown.
  6. App Testing enablement, browser build, actions, findings and changes are unknown.
  7. Secret values, scopes, collaborator roles, deployment propagation and Agent access are unknown.
  8. Task completion, code quality, security, privacy and independent-evaluation results remain unverified.
